behavior.arguments: rdi = start index, rsi = end index, rdx = base pointer, rcx = limit; all index/limit comparisons unsigned (jae/jne), only the two byte gates read signed bytes
behavior.branch_order: rsi < rdi (unsigned) -> 0; rdi > rcx -> 0, rdi == rcx skips the start byte check; start byte in 0x80..0xbf -> 0; rsi > rcx -> 0, rsi == rcx skips the end byte check; end byte in 0x80..0xbf -> 0; else base + rdi
behavior.byte_gate_note: The two gates use different immediates but reject exactly the same set: start gate cmpb $0xc0 + jl fails iff signed byte < -64; end gate cmpb $0xbf + jle fails iff signed byte <= -65. Both are exactly unsigned byte in 0x80..0xbf. Bytes 0x00..0x7f and 0xc0..0xff pass either gate.
behavior.caller_setup: mov 0x48(%rsp),%rdi; mov 0x28(%rsp),%rsi; mov 0x10(%rsp),%rdx; mov 0x18(%rsp),%rcx; call 0x3cd2460 at 0x3cd2aa2; caller purpose beyond that is not claimed
behavior.output_shape: rax = base + rdi on the pass path, 0 on every fail path (eax is zeroed on the fail path; the pass path adds rdi to the base pointer)
behavior.rejected_set: unsigned byte 0x80..0xbf (signed byte -128..-65); stated literally and not assigned to a category
behavior.rejected_set_note: The rejected range coincides with the UTF-8 continuation-byte range. That coincidence is an observation only; no encoding, text, or string meaning is claimed for the base, the indices, or the limit.
behavior.rule: rsi < rdi (unsigned) -> 0; rdi > rcx -> 0; rdi < rcx and signed byte [base+rdi] <= -65 -> 0; rsi > rcx -> 0; rsi < rcx and signed byte [base+rsi] <= -65 -> 0; else base + rdi; rdi == rcx skips the start check and rsi == rcx skips the end check
behavior.scout_correction: The round-10 scout note described the byte gates as 'byte not in 0xc0..0xff -> 0'. That is wrong. The start gate is cmpb $0xc0 + jl, which fails only for signed byte < -64 (unsigned 0x80..0xbf); bytes 0x00..0x7f pass it, verified by overflow analysis of the signed compare (e.g. byte 0x7f: 127 - (-64) = 191 overflows to -65 with SF == OF, so jl is not taken). The end gate (cmpb $0xbf + jle) fails for signed byte <= -65, the same set. The verified rejected set 0x80..0xbf replaces the scout's set everywhere in this packet; all other scouted elements verified exactly (FDE range, 48-byte body, 0 padding, one caller, no naming relocation).
